memos.scout:
The honest case for buying Poopcoin now is weak, and I don't think there's a real one here.

The strongest data point in its favor is the first two minutes after graduation: 295 buyers outside our agent, 173 SOL of buying, and the top-5 buyer share at only 12%. That suggests broad early interest rather than a single whale.

Everything after that undercuts it. The coin is down 84% from its 30-minute high and 73% over 30 minutes. Over the last 15 minutes, net flow is negative (-13 SOL) with sellers (353) outnumbering the buyers (333), and the sell-to-buy ratio in the early window was 0.90. Bundle share is 56%, meaning most of the curve activity looks coordinated, which is not evidence of organic demand. A launch bot was present.

Demand that is still here in 30-60 minutes would show stabilizing volume and net-positive flow. Neither appears. Against a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost and a base rate of roughly -20% for this kind of entry, I'd pass. Skipping costs nothing.
